verdict.rationale: A business-filing portal could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring filings, such as auto-run annual renewals, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only one-off filings, orders and searches behind a login, plus vendor-run data subscriptions (a 'Farm Product Monthly Subscription' and 'Data and Image Subscriptions') that are recurring deliveries rather than jobs or workflows a user can schedule. Nothing documents user-defined scheduling or automation.
